messages:
maria: kicked off a focused A100 vs H100 micro-sweep today — 7B open model (ggml-style weights -> int4/qat) across us-east-1, eu-west-1, and us-west-2. aim: prefill latency, decode latency, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens. short summary below.
samir: awesome, plz include kernel variants and batch sizes. also which quantization path?
maria: used two quant paths: 4-bit symmetric (per-tensor) and QAT-like per-channel with calibration on 5000 prompts. kernels: cutlass matmul and flash-attn-ops where available. batch sizes: single-stream (bs=1), bs=8, bs=32 for throughput.
jia: can you paste the raw numbers (latency, tps, cost) for prefill/decode for bs=1 and bs=8?
maria: paste incoming. note: costs use cloud spot GPU rates we use for benchmarking (A100-80GB spot $1.90/hr, H100-80GB spot $4.40/hr) and converted to $/1M tokens assuming average token time. numbers are median of 10 runs.
```
model, gpu, region, quant, kernel, bs, prefill_ms, decode_ms_per_token, tokens_per_sec, $per_1M_tokens
7B-llama-ish, A100, us-east-1, int4-symm, cutlass, 1, 210, 8.5, 120, 15.8
7B-llama-ish, H100, us-east-1, int4-symm, flash, 1, 160, 6.8, 150, 29.3
7B-llama-ish, A100, us-east-1, qat-pc, cutlass, 1, 230, 9.2, 110, 17.2
7B-llama-ish, H100, eu-west-1, qat-pc, flash, 1, 170, 7.1, 145, 30.5
7B-llama-ish, A100, us-west-2, int4-symm, cutlass, 8, 310, 1.4, 820, 2.3
7B-llama-ish, H100, us-west-2, int4-symm, flash, 8, 260, 1.1, 960, 5.5
7B-llama-ish, A100, us-east-1, int4-symm, cutlass, 32, 980, 0.35, 2200, 0.85
7B-llama-ish, H100, us-east-1, int4-symm, flash, 32, 820, 0.28, 2600, 2.1
```
maria: TL;DR: H100 wins on latency and tokens/sec across the board, but because spot delta is ~2.3x higher we see mixed $/1M tokens depending on utilization. at high throughput (bs>=32) H100 becomes cost-effective for sustained loads; for sporadic single-stream QPS A100 looks cheaper in $/1M tokens for our spot pricing.
oliver: did you also capture kernel-level mem usage and KV cache warmup effects? those can flip prefill numbers.
maria: yes — mem headroom on H100 allowed larger kv cache prefetch leading to ~15ms prefill savings in long contexts (2k tokens). cutlass used ~5-7% less mem on A100 but higher compute time. added short log snippet:
```
[us-east-1 | H100 | flash] prefill: 160ms (kv warm: 18ms)
[us-east-1 | A100 | cutlass] prefill: 210ms (kv warm: 33ms)
```
jia: interesting. any quality diffs from quant paths? QAT looked a bit noisier?
maria: qat-pc had ~0.6% accuracy delta on our eval set vs int4-symm (calibrated) but lower perplexity variance. not significant for most prompts but noticeable on numeric-heavy completions.
bench-bot: scheduled a longer sweep (24h) to validate regional spot churn and latency p99s — job id #bench-176995-02.
samir: next actions: 1) rerun single-stream with flash fallback to cutlass for edge cases 2) collect p50/p90/p99 across regions 3) add $/1M tokens calc for on-demand rates too. can you attach the raw result csv to the ticket?
maria: will upload raw CSV + scripts to the bench ticket and share link. thanks all :rocket:
